subject: Renewal: Volume step-ups & blended rates — Acme Health follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@acmehealth.com>, Jared O'Connor <jared.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & pricing clarification after today’s call

Hi Samantha / Jared —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Goal: Renewal + expansion to add two new routes (clinical-doc routing + patient-support chat) and test a higher-throughput model for summaries.
- Current annual token usage you mentioned: ~75M tokens/month (aggregate across routes) with expected growth to ~120–150M tokens/month in 6–9 months.
- Primary ask: confirm target blended $/1M tokens for budgeting and how step-ups would scale across committed tiers.

Questions I promised to follow up on:
1) Can you confirm the baseline monthly token volume we should model for the renewal (current committed vs typical peak)?
2) Do you have a target budget range for unit economics (e.g., target $/1M tokens or target monthly spend)?
3) Are the new routes expected to be on the same model variants as production today, or are you planning to test a cheaper quantized route for lower-cost outputs?

Attached: preliminary token-volume modeling sheet + our pricing summary (high-level) to help frame the tiers.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm baseline volume + target $/1M, I’ll circulate a blended-rate proposal showing step-up discounts at 1x/3x/5x committed volumes and the expected unit economics for each route/model.
- Michael (cc) will help model the impact of adding a quantized route on latency and cost.

Thanks — would love a quick reply with the baseline and budget range so we can put concrete numbers in front of procurement.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_token_volume_modeling.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), redwood_pricing_summary.pdf (one-page summary)

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing clarification after today’s call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — super helpful. Quick answers below:  

- Baseline: our average month for the last 3 months has been ~78M tokens/month (we've been smoothing traffic but peak days hit ~110M). For the renewal window we should plan on 100M/month as a conservative baseline.
- Budget: procurement is looking for a target blended cost in the neighborhood of $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens across all routes. That gives us wiggle room depending on SLAs & models.
- Routes/models: Clinical-doc routing will need higher fidelity (we expect to keep the current standard model). Patient-support chat is a candidate for a quantized model (lower cost) for quick replies.

We also want visibility on how step-ups would apply if we move from 100M -> 300M/month over the first year — specifically: blended rate at each tier and how per-route model mix changes the blended number. Jared from procurement is looped in for budget approvals.

Samantha
Head of ML Ops, Acme Health

Attachment: procurement requires a simple one-page breakdown they can hand to finance — if you can include a clear $/1M table that would be ideal.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@acmehealth.com>, Jared O'Connor <jared.oconnor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-15T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing clarification after today’s call

Thanks Samantha — this is great and very actionable. I took a pass at a blended-rate proposal based on the 3-tier step-ups you asked about (100M baseline -> 200M -> 300M). High-level bullets below and attached a one-pager for procurement:  

Blended pricing (example tiers, USD per 1M tokens):
- Tier A (commit 100M/mo): $1,050 / 1M tokens (applies to baseline committed volume)
- Tier B (commit 200M/mo): blended $880 / 1M tokens (average across models assuming 70% standard model + 30% quantized)
- Tier C (commit 300M/mo): blended $720 / 1M tokens (70/30 split + additional step-up discount applied to quantized route)

Notes:
- The blended numbers assume the quantized route is ~40% cheaper on unit cost versus standard model; Michael will validate expected latency impact and exact per-token delta.
- If Acme wants to keep clinical-doc routing entirely on the standard model, blended rates shift up ~5–8%.
- We can offer a 6–12 month ramp clause where step-up discounts phase in as you hit monthly committed thresholds to protect both sides during scale.

Next steps:
1) Michael — can you confirm the quantized vs standard per-1M token estimate and expected latency impact (short bullet) so we can finalize the procurement one-pager?
2) Samantha/Jared — if these ranges look directionally correct, I’ll route a formal renewal + addendum with the step-up tiers and a draft SOW attached for legal.

Attached: redwood_pricing_summary.pdf (procurement one-pager), ACME_token_volume_modeling.xlsx (updated assumptions).

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: redwood_pricing_summary.pdf, ACME_token_volume_modeling.xlsx

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-16T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & pricing clarification after today’s call

Quick technical note to confirm numbers:  

- Standard model cost (current production) -> ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens at our current instance mix (this aligns with your current spend profile).
- Quantized route estimate -> ~ $720 / 1M tokens (roughly 40% lower). Latency: expect median latency +12–20ms on our optimized quantized path for short-chat requests, and negligible difference for batch summary jobs.
- Blended math for the 70/30 split at 300M: (0.7 * 1200) + (0.3 * 720) = 1,056 -> we applied additional contractual step-up discount of ~32% across the board to reach the $720 blended number in the proposal (this is negotiable based on committed term).

I’m happy to jump on a short call with procurement to walk through these numbers. If legal/procurement want the exact cost-model assumptions we can include the cost-calculation tab from the attached workbook.

-Michael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: SOW_draft.docx (draft addendum), ACME_token_volume_modeling.xlsx (cost-calculation tab referenced)
